---
name: Add an adopter
about: Add your organization or project to ADOPTERS.md
title: 'Adopter: <organization or project>'
labels: adopter
assignees: ''
---

Thank you for saying where the implementation is being used. Everything below is
voluntary, and an entry can be removed later by opening an issue asking for it.
Do not include anything that is not yours to disclose.

**Organization or project**

<!-- The name to list. A project name is fine if the organization cannot be named. -->

**Use case**

<!-- One or two sentences: what the deployment does. For example, "substation
gateway collecting measurements from feeder protection relays", or "test
harness driving IEDs on a factory acceptance bench". -->

**Protocol roles**

<!-- Which of these are in play. Delete the ones that are not. -->

- [ ] MMS client
- [ ] MMS server
- [ ] GOOSE publisher
- [ ] GOOSE subscriber
- [ ] Sampled Values publisher
- [ ] Sampled Values subscriber
- [ ] SNTP server or client
- [ ] SCL parsing or compile-time model generation
- [ ] TLS per IEC 62351-3

**Scale and environment** (optional)

<!-- Anything that helps a reader judge where the implementation has been
exercised: how many IEDs or associations, the operating system and
architecture, whether it is in production or on a bench. -->

**Since** (optional)

<!-- Roughly when the deployment started, as a year or a year and month. -->

**Contact** (optional)

<!-- A GitHub handle, a team name, or a public address you are willing to have
listed. Leave this empty if you would rather not name anyone; an entry without
a contact is perfectly fine. -->

**Anything else**

<!-- Interoperability findings, equipment you have tested against, or problems
you hit are all welcome here, and are often the most useful part for other
readers. -->
